gates.condition: Resolve the user launch instruction and actual selected studies/resources; this planning task has not executed or admitted the future route. Preserve prior authorization instead of automatically asking again.
Verified fresh cases, archives, constraints, mappings, assessor capacity, budgets and first-save schedule; all source/fit/lineage anchors correct.
Source-bound compressor has zero unsupported extensions and no lower fresh-packet complete retention than ordinary; diagnostic failures remain separate. Ties confer no benefit claim.
Proposed probe has an informative observation within actual available resources; deployment and physical/human evidence remain separately gated. A budget cap alone is insufficient.
For optional human/physical work, freeze actual access, oracle/materials, assignments, observation units and separate budgets before launch.

Every scheduled unit has source-bound outputs and observed native terminal disposition, independent judgments and unresolved/gated accounting; design/progress/audit events cannot substitute for experimental joins.
No global originality, whole Robot Talks efficacy, physical synergy or human decision benefit from stage-only or model-judged comparisons; validator success is structural only.

observability.receipt_partition_policy: Typed design/preparation/experiment/review/adjudication/audit/repair events; no implicit ledger tail or file-only terminal witness.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Independent matched arm outputs and blind dual assessments in a future launched study.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Future roles identify responsibilities only. No capability-bound runtime admission or new trial execution is claimed by this plan. Current Distill planning roles are separately recorded in planning-events.jsonl.

roles.purpose: Prepare source-bound cases, archives and anchors without candidate leakage
Run exact assigned first-save stages; ordinary/generic/operator controls
Review opaque assessed objects without sibling judgments
Check actual scheduled coverage, source mappings, terminal witnesses and costs

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: At future launch, resolve the selected studies and actual resource scope from the user instruction then in force. Do not request confirmation again where scope is already authorized.

promotion_guardrails: Candidate research plan only. Structure validation does not establish experimental validity, operational adoption or canonical promotion.
portfolio_dependencies: Each selected study also honors its exact depends_on list and phase gates in portfolio.json; a wave is not permission to bypass them.
